# Careers@GFTV

> Careers@GFTV is the recruitment portal for Global Furry Television, a
> volunteer run furry television project. It lists the roles that are open and
> it is where somebody applies for one. Roles are voluntary and unpaid unless
> the posting itself says otherwise, and every posting states which it is.

The portal is published in English and in Singapore Mandarin. The language is a
preference stored in the reader's own browser rather than part of the address,
so every URL below serves English to anything arriving without one.

Applying needs a free applicant account, which takes a moment and needs no
approval. The application form itself is linked from a posting once somebody is
signed in, so its address is not public and is not in this file. Reading the
board and every posting on it needs no account at all.

## Roles

- [Open roles](https://careers.globalfurry.tv/search): every published posting, filterable by team, tag, commitment type, location and closing date.
- [Openings feed](https://careers.globalfurry.tv/api/public/jobs.json): the same postings as JSON, for anyone aggregating openings. One entry per posting, carrying its title, summary, team, commitment type, whether it is paid, and its canonical link.

## About the portal

- [About Careers@GFTV](https://careers.globalfurry.tv/about): what GFTV is, what volunteering here involves, and how an application is handled from start to finish.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://careers.globalfurry.tv/faq): accounts, applying, languages, and what happens after an application goes in.
- [Build status](https://careers.globalfurry.tv/status): the portal is being released in phases, and this page says which parts are live and which are not built yet.

## Worth knowing

- A posting's canonical address is `/jobs/` followed by the posting's uuid. A link carrying a slug redirects to it.
- A closed posting stays readable and cannot be applied to. A posting with no closing date is open until it is filled.
- Nothing on this site is a paid job advertisement unless the posting says it is paid.
